To ensure that every device can be recorded to the patient on whom it is used, the GS1 coding system has been adopted by the HSE, and this coding standard allows for consistency across HSE hospitals. The Track and Trace application is centrally hosted on prem in HSE datacentres and runs using Citrix thin client technology on designated PCs in the relevant operational areas. There is a Citrix presented instance of the application for each site. The back end database construct features a suite of Microsoft SQL servers, with each individual hospital site having its own distinct set of SQL databases corresponding to each site s specific Citrix published application instance hosted on one centrally managed Citrix VDA suite. The MSSQL Database servers are hosted in three x 3 node High Availability Windows Server Failover Cluster environments, with site instances of the application spread across these three clusters for load balancing.
